items.title: GE Vernova Stock In Focus After Germany Wind Turbine Order
items.summary: GE Vernova reported that Stadtwerke Heidenheim AG ordered three 5.5 MW onshore wind turbines for the Schlotberg Jüchsen project in Germany, with locally manufactured hardware, commissioning targeted for December 2027, and a 20 year service agreement. The 16.5 MW order extends a long running partnership that now reaches 74 MW of installed GE Vernova onshore wind capacity for Stadtwerke Heidenheim in Germany, reinforcing recurring service revenue tied to a growing European fleet.
